sections.section: 1. Reconcile the pool with customer allocations
sections.note: Overview showed 4 purchased / 1 allocated / 3 available after reload, matching co_managed_entitlements and live allocations. The client used was White Rabbit, not a disposable client: guide 01, which creates the disposable client, runs after this guide.

Simulator only. The pool went from 4 to 5. The review showed '5 seats · $57.45 per month, Estimated amount due now: $11.49'. Capacity stayed at 4 while the purchase was only under review and became 5 after the simulator verified it. The simulator subscription sub_774424209 quantity became 5, recorded as operation 93d614ae-4d37-4c9c-84e3-6f8db619bb4f. The existing subscription was updated, so no hosted checkout session was opened and Resume purchase was never offered. A labelled direct server-action probe resent the same operation id. It returned 200 and created no new operation, no quantity change and no new simulator event. It did bump co_managed_entitlements.revision (6 to 7), which looks like re-verification. Not real Stripe.

White Rabbit went from 1 to 2 seats. After reload the pool read 5 purchased / 2 allocated / 3 available. With a value of 0, Save allocation was disabled (min 1, White Rabbit has 1 active technician). Asking for more than was available opened a shortfall review: 'Add 1 seat to the sponsor pool (new total 6).' It was not confirmed, and capacity did not change. The allocation was restored to 1 through the same dialog. No pending invitations existed, so the invitation part of the floor was not exercised.

This is a hosted deployment. The pool editor offers Review purchase, not Manage license. Visiting /msp/licenses directly redirected to /msp/dashboard. Installing a signed licence, lapse and renewal could not be run: there is no operator-supplied signed test licence and no self-hosted installation.

steps: Signed in as qa@emeraldcity.oz through the real form
Opened Co-managed IT overview, read Purchased/Allocated/Available, reloaded
Opened White Rabbit client > Co-managed IT > Change seat allocation and compared the pool line; cancelled
Set Total seats in your pool from 4 to 5, Review purchase, read monthly total and amount due, Confirm purchase
Reloaded the overview until 5 purchased was shown; compared with the simulator subscription quantity
Labelled probe: resent the same purchase operation id directly to the server action; compared operations, quantity and events
White Rabbit > Change seat allocation 1 -> 2, Save allocation, reloaded and reopened
Entered 0 (Save disabled); entered a value one seat over availability, Save allocation, read shortfall review (new total 6), dismissed without confirming
Restored White Rabbit allocation to 1 and reloaded
Confirmed the hosted pool editor shows no Manage license link; visited /msp/licenses (redirected to dashboard)
Retained state: set pool back to 4, Review purchase, Confirm purchase, reloaded
outcomes: Pool 4 -> 5 after simulator verification, then 5 -> 4 (net retained 4). Before this recording a failed attempt left the pool at 4 (3 -> 4, operation da1cdd56). That seat is kept as headroom for guide 01.
4 purchase operations exist (3, 4, 5, 4), all completed against simulator subscription sub_774424209. Receipts are retained.
White Rabbit allocation is back to 1 (active). Allocated total is 1.
limitations: Configured Stripe simulator (127.0.0.1:9175), not real Stripe. It certifies no live SKU or price.
The purchase updated an existing simulator subscription, so the embedded checkout and Resume purchase path was not exercised.
Allocation checks used the active White Rabbit relationship (+1, restored) instead of a disposable client, because of the requested guide order.
The shortfall purchase from the client allocation dialog was reviewed but not paid.
The same-operation replay is a direct server-action probe, not a UI flow.
Self-host signed licence, lapse and renewal were not exercised.
The header on every MSP page shows the raw tenant UUID (fa7f912f-...) as a pill. This is an observation, not a guide check.
missingResources: Real Stripe test account with the co-managed seat price (release-owner acceptance)
Operator-supplied tenant-bound signed self-host test licence on an isolated self-hosted installation, plus a lapse/renewal lifecycle fixture
